title: Vouchers and virtual cash can't be used on sale goods
review: They have written to me several times to ask me to provide a review despite giving no answer to my reply to them, so here goes.If a company excludes vouchers and their own virtual cash from being used for special offers or sale goods, then what is the point in providing vouchers and virtual cash to existing customers because it means existing customers have no benefit over new customers at sale times. The only reason any business applies such a policy is to enable them to reduce the prices generally to get new business instead of retaining some margin to give extra to their loyal cuatomers. Being an existing customer and getting vouchers and virtual cash is no help unless you want to buy something that is NOT on sale or if you want to buy a product outside sale periods. Since things are regularly on sale, it's almost futile. Sorry to be so blunt about this, but I believe that existing customers should always have greater benefits than new ones. When I ran my own business I retained customers by always offering special deals that were not offered to new customers. It's a short-sighted approach to make new customers your only focus.

review: Was recently “cold called” at work to be told that my bill was going up next month. Bloke on the phone was disinterested and very dismissive of the increase. I told him that because of his attitude I would be cancelling my subscription as a 16 year customer. HOWEVER, when I used the chat to discuss me leaving, the assistant couldn’t have been better. I told him about the previous interaction and that I had found a cheaper alternative to subscribe too. After he looked into the situation he came back with a deal that will save me £40 a month, and give me more, including a mini box. And to cap it off, the new box arrived less than 24 hours later! Admittedly it would be nice for Sky to always try and offer their customers the best deal possible, and not just wait for the threat of cancellation, but on this occasion I was pleased with the outcome. Maybe try and train your cold callers better too.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Sky Fibre Broadband Installation
review: Signed up for Sky Fibre Broadband in September.Relatively seamless installation/connection. Hiccup with one missed call but in fairness it was a difficult installation due to remote location.Just a shame Sky TV is as co-ordinated.Would recommend based on price and service I received. Certainly far superior to the cowboys at Talk Talk.Thank you Sky.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Good Service
review: I had a hard time reinstating my Sky account after it had been locked for some reason. (I still don't know why.) However I encountered some extremely helpful staff, Rohad, Aysha and Natalie amongst others, and one particularly cheerful lady from Dunfermline who at least made me smile. I was at my wits end after three days of constant phone calls but cannot fault the service in the staff trying to help me. So thank you everyone for your help and patience. My sanity and Sky account are restored!

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: I like Sky, getting to support is becoming a problem
review: I like Sky, when you get hold of someone they are amazing. The issue for me, the tech call system does not cater for  anything outside there minimum list of problems. Seem to be pushing you to the community to resolve own issue. They are trying to reduce calls for minor quick fix issues. To get to tech support had to go through cancellation to pass through twice. I am starting to see many companies going down this route.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: trustpilot sky servicegreat hope it helps with…
review: trustpilot great hope it helps with Sky. must be the worst customer service of all. 4 emails plus and 2 telephone conversations I managed to talk to someone about contract. both said they would phone back, no reply. latest one Cetan ? said he would phone back with quote on wednesday still no response. I am over paying no answer from them. I suppose they might reply soon as I am about to stop/cancel my direct debit!!!

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: High quality, if expensive TV
review: Their service is fantastic and rarely drops out. There were some issues last year wherein the sky box would say I had no Wi-Fi connection when in fact the Wi-Fi was in full working order, but in the last six months, this hasn’t happened once, so I assume sky have taken steps to repair this glitch. Yes, their TV service is expensive, but it is high quality and you get what you pay for.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: You should review who you employ to do customer service
review: The first guys I spoke with were shocking and not willing to make any changes to my package that went up over £30. Poor English and clueless of what they were doing.I want to praise Shannon big time for being so helpful!! Very attentive, listen to what you need and simply amazing!! She was able to deal with my query quick with no hassle!You really should start thinking of employing more staff like Shannon,you'll definitely not only won't have as many complaints but you'll definitely gain and attract more customers. Just saying ..

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Always been ok for me :)
review: Been with SKY TV for a while, never really had any issues, only thing I will say is the Sky Movies are absolutely pointless and may as well just give it up! Will be cancelling movies as soon as my contract is up. Apart from that it's always been good for me - don't have BB with them as I'm with another provider who bundles all my energy and BB into one otherwise I would think about taking them up on it. Overall I can't complain.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Sky is pricey but like anything else if…
review: Sky is pricey but like anything else if you use what you pay for it's a pretty good deal. I think it's easy to get over-sold or suckered into bits you don't need or won't use more than once or twice a month.When you compare them against the alternatives they generally came out better for what we want (things like entertainment tv, cinema, and netflix...most things except sports). What we like is spread across lots of different providers now which you need seperate subscriptions for so sky is a good option as you get quite a lot of it included compared to the pricing if you went with BT and then had to get seperate subscriptions for things like paramount+.We've also started using the free monthly cinema tickets and it's got us back to appreciating the cinema.Over the last year and a half there have probabily been less than a handful of times where there has been an issue with the fibre but they've sorted it out quite quickly.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Excellent service, once you have waited
review: Pretty decent customer service......but you have to wait 25mins for it, but as long as you pass this test, you will be looked after very well - in fact, these guys have always been excellent, just dont let the wait annoy you and stay positive and you will get your issue sorted :)

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Massive thank you to James from Sky…
review: Massive thank you to James from Sky customer service. He was extremely helpful and friendly! He went above and beyond my expectations and ensured I felt satisfied with the advice given. However I called Sky customer service today at 4:21pm. The customer services advisor I initially spoke to did not seem to care about my issue and advised due to my advising the broadband is slow, he would speak to the technical team and placed me on hold. I was on hold for 1 hour and 22 minutes before the advisor cut the line off. As expected I was fuming with the service provided. I then called back and was put through to James. He is a massive credit to the company and should be recognised for his hard work and kindness. He spoke through my issue, completed some checks for speed etc and provided me great advice.Thank you James! You deserve a pay rise

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment

Not sponsored , I don’t think 🤔 it’s supposed to do that? (not as advertised). Sky Glass has bad points but sound wise and a fondness for YouTube n live music 🎶 Brilliant

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Managed to renew with an upgrade for less than I was paying
review: Didn't realise that I had gone out of contract (1 star knocked off for not letting me know) but managed to renew and upgrade my broadband to fibre and get a couple of pound knocked off vs what I was paying which was a surprise.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment

title: Sky review
review: Just terrible in every way, got my phone out with them, just paying for the phone as I got a free sim as I use EE, but when I selected 24 months to pay my phone off it put me on a 36 month plan, so annoyingUpdate:Support is good, and if your using them purely just to get devices because it’s cheaper or you got something another operator didn’t have like a MacBook I’d recommend, but I’d be careful on the tv as last time i know someone who was getting charged £60 a month for it!

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Good customer service
review: Our internet was cut off due to unexpected vet bills so wasn’t able to pay and I work from home so this was a massive problem!Idk who I spoke to on the phone but she was amazing and did everything she could to get us back up and running and she did it, I have my internet and only need to pay the extra on top of my next bill.If it wasn’t for this lady in the payment department, idk what id do. Thank you lady.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Wanted to restructure my current…
review: Wanted to restructure my current package and their customer service was very helpful in finding a deal that worked better for me. Got through to someone quick and was all sorted within 15 minutes.

title: The guy (sorry didn't get his name) I…

review: I wasn't happy with the service provided by sky, phoned up to change my deal and was passed around like a parcel. eventually i got to speak to someone who knew what they were actually doing. I am happy that my issue was finally resolved but took a lot of work getting it resolved.

title: Replacement Q box and viewing card…
review: Replacement Q box and viewing card arrived - only for it to be faulted. Card not clicking and just getting jammed in slot. Spoke with customer services who couldn’t get an engineer sorted. Pay a lot of money for this! Are Sky sending out reconditioned q boxes? Update on this - rang next day and bingo got an excellent person who is sorting everything out. Did get another call from overseas which suggests there’s a process improvement somewhere in terms of comms as already handled here in the UK.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: One of the best
review: Honestly, compared to most other providers (except Virgin and BT), you won't find any better. Sky are great, the support is so much better than all the others that outsource to untrained call centres who will not deviate from a script. We do have a speed slower than promised but it's working better than any other we can get here.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Sky last bill after termination of contract.
review: While terminating broadband or tv or talk contracts with sky, their last bill is always debited with next whole month package charges. This has happened in past as well. Last bill should only be charged for the days until Sky service was provided. Surprisingly after calling Sky about last billing overcharged, they will provide with reference number and we need to call them again after a month on billing date with this reference number. This is absolutely unacceptable. Sky have thousands of customers and if they keep one month bill amount for 30 days how much they get out of that money?

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Broadband is fine
review: So far. Far better experience than the scum at YouFibre who harassed me over a week and turned up.on my doorstep ro bully me in taking out a contract.Sky works so far. Price is acceptable and moving to them was relatively painless.

review: I have freesat, and out of the blue sky called offering me full TV with sport for £27 a mth. It's on my sky hd box, but a no brainer. description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Disappointed.
review: Been with Sky for 18 years but sadly when my contract is up soon ,I'm out.Proposed monthly increase is too much and there are better deals available elsewhere.Beware of differing lengths of contract for different products eg.Talk being separate from broadband.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment

I phoned up a little irate and got Chris from Edinburgh I think, the only person who's ever calmed me down when I've been mad! He helped me for two weeks getting this sorted,  phoned me with updates every day and kept his promises.  Eventually sorted thanks to him, sky you have a diamond staff member there,  hang on to him!

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Mixed bag
review: Currently Sky provide me with a solid service and a competitive price so I can't complain. There have been problems though and I found that customer services weren't always helpful... however once we got on the same page they quickly fixed the problems and showed a little good will to compensate the problems with the service.I scored a 3 as I think the company does provide me what a signed up for but it took a little time to get there.I think Sky could easily raise the bar by being on point from day 1 and from my perspective this would qualify for a 4 star rating.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Great customer service, pricey
review: Great customer service, very helpful. Very reliable internet so far, fast speeds, no drop in connection. A little pricey for packages. Sky states good deals but extra add-ons push prices up. Calls not included unless you take on an extra add-on bundle. Would I recommend? It's good for me but just be aware that what you see is not always what you get

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: I'm a new customer of Sky..
review: I'm a new customer of Sky (service started 1st March), left Virgin because of the ever increasing extortionate cost of broadband/tv package. So I was surprised and not particularly impressed to receive an email recently from Sky informing me of a price rise from May. I thought I would at least get 12 months usage from Sky before any price rises, not 2 months. This has certainly changed my mind about staying with Sky after my 18 months contract ends. Currently the service is 'ok', broadband is slow at times. The only positive is the ability to get Netflix free and to be able to subscribe to Disney!

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Sky TV is perfectly fine if expensive
review: Sky TV is perfectly fine if expensive.   Sky Mobile on the other hand I can't recommended as they've configured their LTE/4G calling service to sound like 2G.Customer services were great however.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: It's a shame that Sky are so difficult…
review: It's a shame that Sky are so difficult to contact. It took most of a day to set up a new subscription and upgrade. When you do get through to the UK based call handlers, they are very helpful, but there is either something wrong with the software or they are understaffing. I dread having to contact them again and will almost certainly cancel at the end of this contract if things don't improve.

Overall I am happy with the reliability of both broadband and TV services...although the price is now a big factor and may force me to change supplier

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: THE SMAll PRINT?
review: I have recently cancelled my account with Sky because I consider it far too expensive.Sky have been very persistent in trying to get me to reconsider with phone calls and letters.The letters offer a considerable reduction in cost if I sign up to a new contract. MAJOR PROBLEM - I would need a magnifying glass to read it.I will not put myself through this and not reconsider my decision to renew my contract.There are many other options out there especially streaming that cost nothing.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Hidden Admin Fees
review: Went to renew my broadband with them (been a customer for years) and they were offering it a the same price as before (saying that they were applying a £5 discount to keep it the same but charging me a £10 admin fee for the pleasure).Rang them and to be fair gave me a couple of quid off the monthly.  Wouldn't scrap the admin fee though.  Just find it annoying that despite being connected to them already as an existing customer on the service that are making me pay them for the offer they have made to me!?Companies hiding behind the word "Admin Fee" .. they just want to make an easy ten quid from me basically .. there is no admin involved.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Rip-off
review: All TV packages are overly expensive & Sky is no exception. It’s bad enough feeling that it’s generally not good value but to then be asked to pay even more to ‘skip ads’ is disgraceful when we’re already paying a lot for the occasional new program & a whole bunch of re-runs. I just wish they would stop being so damned greedy.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: Broadband became shocking from the date I announced I was leaving, what a coincidence!
review: Been with sky broadband for four years and also had the signature tv package for pretty much the same time and never ever had a single problem with the broadband. Another well known company have a faster broadband available for a lesser price, and sky unfortunately were unable to match this price by quite a considerable amount. Due to a better and cheaper broadband service provider being available, I have ultimately as you would expect, taken the decision to leave sky broadband. My switching date is 23rd December (a couple of days from now) and what would be the chances of my broadband being for the first time in four years, very unreliable, slow, and let’s say shocking? For this reason when my sky TV contract runs out in January, I’ll be cancelling this also. Thanks sky for a very reliable 4 years; minus the two weeks time since I let you know I’m switching!

Contacted Sky and was told the deal was for new customers only. I asked why it shows those deals in an existing customer account. No Answer. Once my contract expires I am moving to another provider as I am totally disgusted with the sharp practise.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment
title: I was a Sky customer for over 25years…
review: I was a Sky customer for over 25years until 4th November. I never once in all that time missed a payment but I didn't like the change in direction since their recent takeover. I gave a month's notice and left on 4th November after being quoted an outrageous quote for a new contract. I was promised a new offer would be made within a week,before the week was up I received a text message stating it would be a further week before this particular lady would contact me.That day I cancelled everything and dually left. After my 25 years experience I recently received a text stating I had not returned my equipment, which I had and sent details and never received a reply, totally they have sent me a bill for £28.47 with no explanation except to say extra charges will be added if not paid. As I never missed a payment in over 25 years I find a strange attitude, surely I phone and explanation would have been the proper thing to do. I this is the American way of doing business I can understand why the are losing so many customers. I would advise any of thinking of joining Sky to think again. Service engineers...fine, everything else REALLY BAD VALUE FOR MONEY.

description: Sky.com Your Home for the Latest Sky News, Sports & Entertainment

The internet is very slow, the tv service is overpriced. My current contract is £109 a month for internet, basic sky with sports, Netflix and Disney plus. I have ended my contract and moved to now tv with faster internet x2, Netflix, sports and EE tv with sky cinema for half of what I’d pay sky! So much for loyalty, new customers get significantly cheaper deals!

title: Shop great/Experience poor
review: I have been going to Vinyl Tap since it was based in Leeds near the corn exchange, then it moved to Halifax and finally to Huddersfield. The guy that originally ran the shop, he was brilliant, felt very comfortable going in, he was chatty and knew his stuff. There was a period when this shop went online only for a bit and I was disappointed but happy for him, that he could continue, however fast forward a few years and this place feels cold and uninviting, that guy is no longer there. You walk in and you are immediately clocked as though you are already under suspicion, once you are clocked and you are about to say hello, both gents look away, so why bother? I once asked where the CD singles were as they are advertised online, and I got a very dismissive response to say that you need to buy them online, they are not stored here! I am a massive Madonna fan and usually these guys do the ‘Record Sales day’ and often have her rare stuff, but I have never had a comfortable transaction especially with these two guys. Luckily for Huddersfield, there is a coffee shop that does vinyl and sometime the records sales day, so will be going there in future.Shop contents 5 stars, experience 0 - average 3 starsPS - Expect to pay £1 for a carrier bag, but the price is not mentioned when asked if you want one, so please be mindful of that.

The books were therefore left outside between my dustbins for several days and were damp through when I returned home.  I had to contact Cewe again to raise this issue.  I am pleased that my concerns were addressed seriously and quickly with a further urgent reprint arranged.  I was advised I would get a dispatch email this time.  This time I got a tracking email and was at home when the package arrived.  I now have the correct number of photo books at the quality expected and I am pleased with them. I am also pleased with customer services in terms of getting speedy reprints done for me.  However, the absent dispatch email and the delivery issues spoiling the books has been an issue and was frustrating in that I had to follow up twice.  Hence my 3 stars.

title: Not “Great”
review: I placed my first order with Horizons before doing any research or checking of reviews. I ordered 3 items all vinyl records. They offered me a £5 credit in respect of the damaged record, and stated it was impossible to know the colour of the other item (black or white) as the vinyl was sealed. However they had this two listings on the website for this record with the white version being more expensive than the standard black vinyl. This seems to be one of the main issues with this company, i.e. a misleading website that shows records that are available but it is pot luck if you actually get what you order. I subsequently received an email from Horizons which sated that if I write a review on Trustpilot I would be entered into a draw for a £25 gift voucher (incentive), which it should be noted goes against Trustpilot’s guidelines. Unfortunately I would not recommend using this company.

title: Shopping experience for a 61 note midi controller…
review: Shopping for a 61 note midi controller keyboard to connect to an ipad to play as part of a live rig.Music matter had plenty choice advertised online and the sales assistant was good with some very helpful suggestions. Took my iPad with the hope of a getting a good test drive but the big disappointment was that I was not permitted to try or even view the actual product out of the box that I wanted in advance of purchase, but given the caveat that I could return if not satisfactory. Being a traditional piano player, the feel and response of the keyboard is of prime importance, and it was not particularly helpful being shown a 25 note version that wasn’t able to be plugged in. My other potential purchase ‘option’ was displayed vertically on a wall ! - not a great way to help me decide. Maybe I’m being unrealistic in my expectations but it ended up felling similar to an online click / collect / option to return experience Overall, the price was good and the service satisfactory. To date, the purchase is ok but there are a couple of things I’m disappointed with which would have been obvious with a trialHowever I think it’s good to support such a specialist shop these days and I would definitely return to consider my next purchase.

title: Customer service tried to help but issues with misquoted shipping rates left a bad taste in my mouth. Check before ordering!
review: We are a husband and wife, both of us have  played and worked in music and audio for many years. As we live in NW Scotland we regularly use a wide range of different musical suppliers, both from the UK and internationally, usually via the internet. I had a very mixed bag of an experience whilst trying to buy something from Music Matter this morning after noticing a discrepancy between the advertised costs in their shipping FAQ and the shipping costs added at the basket. My initial query was taken by a helpful customer service agent who said they would escalate it and they did get back to me after a short time, but unfortunately with incorrect information given to them by the director with whom they had gone to check. I had been looking at making a purchase from Music Matter this morning, of an item that was advertised as having free UK mainland delivery. As I live in NW Scotland I checked to see if there would be a surcharge - sadly for my location there often is with online retail. There was a page on the website which  clearly laid out shipping costs to various locations and this stated that although free delivery was not available for my postcode, delivery on this item (calculated by postcode + retail price bracket, all clearly displayed) would be £14.99. However when I put the item in my basket this shipping cost suddenly rose to £26.80!  I contacted customer service who asked for some time to go check on this mispricing issue. The agent called me back quite quickly and said that they had checked with the director and he had confirmed to her that the £26.80 pricing was correct. I was further told this is what the director had said the courier was charging them and they were merely passing the cost on. The courier in question (DPD) is one that delivers items to us at this location at least a couple of times a week. in fact during the course of the conversation with customer service a DPD parcel arrived of a similarly sized, similarly priced item from another UK music retailer (based only a short distance from Music Matter) for which I only had to pay £2.99 in shipping costs.Initially I was given no explanation as to why the pricing on the website should differ from the basket price. I had to contact customer service again to query this. I was then told (again incorrectly it would seem) that the shipping costs advertised on Music Matter's website were in fact innacurate and out of date, the £26.80 being the new price following a change of courier company. Whilst I was thanked for pointing this out Music Matter did not at that point make any offer to supply the item at the shipping cost as displayed on the web site.In fairness to the 2 customer service assistants I spoke to they were both helpful, although one did say to me "Well we don't have that many customers from the Hebrides so it doesn't really matter". I'm sure he didn't mean it in the way it came out but it did make me feel somewhat undervalued. One of the agents did ring me back to say that the director had in fact given her incorrect info at first, and when this was double checked a website error was identified, whereby the shipping cost should be £14.99 as per their shipping FAQ. However no explanation was offered as to why my query had initially been dismissed by the director or why incorrect information was given to the agent when she initially escalated the query. I was thanked for making them aware of the website pricing error and offered the option to complete the purchase with the corrected delivery price, but by this time I felt that I didn’t really want to give my money to a company whose director  had given inaccurate and misleading information, whilst displaying so little care for their customers or staff. Furthermore, once the agent was aware that I probably wasn't going to make the purchase anyway, I was told there were several people waiting on the line and our call was cut short. It's a shame that when I tried to buy a competetively priced product from a UK based retailer, the transaction should fail due to a combination of misinformation on the website and further misinformation given by management who failed to take ownership of a mistake they had made, appeared dismissive of the issue I raised, unconcerned about the experience of their customers, and left their customer service staff to try and clear up the mess that they had made as a result. None of it is really motivating me to consider buying from Music Matter in the future, nor based on today’s experience would I be able to recommend them.

title: Did not arrive by Christmas as promised.
review: I purchased three books - one on 13 Dec and two on 14 Dec, both with the understanding that they would be delivered before Christmas (estimated 20 December - you can see it in my account's order history). FWIW, for both orders, the site said I needed to purchase by 15 December in order to arrive before Christmas.  Much to my dismay, all three arrived together on 26 December, (after a UPS to USPS hand-off that occurred on 21 December - yes, I was anxiously tracking the three purchases daily).  I am extremely disappointed, especially after having to pay a $9.99 S&H fee for the first purchase and a $10.99 S&H fee for the second.  The books themselves were very nice, but given the price (including the S&H charges totaling almost $180) Wonderbly should have taken the necessary steps to ensure the delivery was on time.  Would I purchase again?  Only if I built in a full month's worth of lead time.

title: Poor choice of delivery company
review: Dealing with the books was, as always, impressively fast. Using Whistl is not ideal, because they actually delegate the task to Evri. The books I recently ordered came in three separate parcels, which is fine, but Evri sent me three separate notifications of delivery between 20.00 and 21.00 on 31st August. Knowing I would be out, I sent three separate instructions to redirect Evri to put the parcels in my garage. I was therefore surprised to receive 3 messages at 15.00 to say the parcels had been delivered, given that I was still at home and no-one had knocked the front door. I was even more surprised upon opening the front door to find the three parcels neatly stacked up leaning against it. Fortunately we're a law abiding neighbourhood round here but absolutely anyone could have walked off with them!  I don't understand why Blackwells uses such an unreliable delivery company.

I said as a joke “Oh, I thought you were in the cupboard”, which she wasn’t literally. Glaring at me, with a look that could kill, she admonished: “I was in the cupboard AND with a customer”. Call me oversensitive, but I was upset for most of the rest of the day, and frightened to return. I have since ordered books from Bookshop.org. Previously I had supported Blackwell’s in preference to Amazon in order to protect my local bookshop. Since they have been taken over by Waterstone’s, that no longer seems a priority. Whatever happened to prioritizing and being polite to customers?  I didn’t realise that staff are hired to protect their own wellbeing. And what about sense of humour?

description: World Of Books Group is a circular economy, for-profit business that supports charities and protects the planet by enabling more goods to be reused. From a single bag of books we now re-home and recycle over 75 million used books a year. We buy books from charity shops and other sources, or through Ziffit – our App and website. We sell them on our own website and on other platforms – we are the largest volume seller on eBay globally. Our recycling partners turn unwanted books into other useful products – nothing goes to waste. This is supported by our own proprietary software platform which streamlines our processes. We also provide software services to charities and other re-sellers to help them maximise their e-commerce sales. As a recently accredited B Corp (Business For Good), we are growing quickly in the UK and internationally. With nearly 300,000 sq ft of warehouses in Cincinnati (US), West Sussex (UK) and a new state-of-the-art warehouse in Coventry (UK), sales in 2020 will be nearly £80 million. Our company was founded on an ethos to do good, to help charities and to make a positive impact. We don’t believe that books should only be read once, or have a single owner. We want to share the love of literature by rereading and reusing books. This is why our prices are low and delivery is free - to help millions of used books find new homes in over 190 countries every year.
title: Bargain books worth the wait.
review: Made a purchase for my daughter. Ordered three books, they sent one and one wrong book. I sent a message to customer service who were helpful in rectifying the fault and fulfilling the order. It took a while and a few replies but all was sorted in the end. There isn't any phone lines and if you Google the number, it says COVID has stopped the phone line. I would purchase from again as prices are more than reasonable and the condition is quite acceptable.

title: So painfully slow and still dodgy to use.
review: Receiving books from World of Books is great. I appreciate the value of second-hand books, and they are generally as described. However, Ziffit is now trading as World of Books, and I feel compelled to leave a review as somebody who has traded books in more than once. This company has a lot of scope for improvement. Everything is so damned slow! Parcels are collected casually, items are logged into the warehouse leisurely and payouts (more to be said later) are plodding. How can it take weeks for items to be received before they are even checked?As for the checking of items in the warehouse, they are still up to their little 'tricks'... items are often rejected for the most imaginative of reasons. I once had a map rejected for mould even though it was brand new and had been received from Amazon the day before sending it! Also, the prices paid out are scandalous given the amount they charge for second-hand text books, for instance, one text book they paid me 42p for is now on sale for £6.69. A complete rip off.

We sell them on our own website and on other platforms – we are the largest volume seller on eBay globally. Our recycling partners turn unwanted books into other useful products – nothing goes to waste. This is supported by our own proprietary software platform which streamlines our processes. We also provide software services to charities and other re-sellers to help them maximise their e-commerce sales. As a recently accredited B Corp (Business For Good), we are growing quickly in the UK and internationally. With nearly 300,000 sq ft of warehouses in Cincinnati (US), West Sussex (UK) and a new state-of-the-art warehouse in Coventry (UK), sales in 2020 will be nearly £80 million. Our company was founded on an ethos to do good, to help charities and to make a positive impact. We don’t believe that books should only be read once, or have a single owner. We want to share the love of literature by rereading and reusing books. This is why our prices are low and delivery is free - to help millions of used books find new homes in over 190 countries every year.

title: The bot is more helpful than the customer service on email

The website directs you towards a bot, which seemed better placed than many and said it would send my request as a matter of urgency. The order was placed at 6.47pm. The message went at 6.58pm.A reply came the next day at 8.23am to say the order couldn’t be cancelled, to wait for it to arrive, and then to post back. This seems pretty daft so I explained my issue and asked if anything could be done (I wanted to add extra books to the order and use an alternative promotion). It also seemed very wasteful to send items back and forth and I was dubious as to whether the items had in fact been sent, given the order was placed in an evening and immediately queried. I was told no and the email back was rather direct in tone and dismissive.I appreciate sometimes things cannot be done, but I think some level of customer service and understanding of the issue would have gone a long way. I will seriously consider whether to use WOB moving forward, I do not feel like a valued customer.

title: I look forward to the day..
review: ... or is it going to be month or year? - that the BBC finally decides not to show needles going into arms with such dull, graphic frequency.We get the point. *I will also celebrate the day when its reasonably paid, high quality journalists discipline themselves to, by single example, speak proper. To both say and write 'has' where grammatically correct as opposed to almost universally instead using 'have' would be a great start. **Some does. Most doesn't. Innit. Whatever happened to BBC English? By example:The BBC  HAS decided not to show needles going into arms all the damned time  The next of kin HAS been informed Liverpool HAS not had a good run of form lately The European Union HAS not yet decided either way. Oh, but it will at the very last minute. It's simple, shurely. For singular, use 'has.'For plural... yep, you has got the idea. Odd exceptions excepted. Pull your socks up, BBC. Please. .. Even Jim can't fix this, it seems.On the plus side.. ? Despite quite a relentless bashing since our Jim did indeed fix it and, out of respect to him, we all then got to know about it in 2011, I consider BBC News to be the most trustworthy media outlet globally. Even though it is indisputably left leaning. Just look at the Newsnight staff. For e.g. Emily Maitlis, Kirsty Walk, Lewis Goodhall... really rather LEFT. But, entertaining nonetheless. Its a programme I enjoy very much. BBC's newsreaders are well worth separate attention; top dogs, me thinks: each and every. And, thank Gawd (or whoever we may currently be allowed to refer to), all lack the sometime-melodrama of ITN and so, inherently resist adding their pennyworth to serious news items. Tom Bradby would not do well at the BBC because he would not be encouraged to crocodile-tear his conclusion to a sad story. Or frown at the baddies. And that would make him very sad. On the lighter stories, the BBC also get it just right. Sorry, gets it just right. Oh, it doesn't matter. Martin Croxall and Simone McCoy handle those little babies with especial aplomb. Oh, that twinkle. And Front Cover Tom, the naughty weather doll, has his moments also.But.. (And?).. .. It's true, it's true.. 1. I do believe it subliminally represents itself rather too well and too often as left-biased (BBC in general, across its political output) 2. I do believe it very shoddily and grudgingly represented any pro Brexit standpoint 3. I do believe that, post-Savile, Management has - or is it 'have?'-crawled up its own b/side many times with what has seemed a squalid frenzied attempt at latent 'political correctness.'And such a stupid phrase, that. There, I've said it. Much like 'Multiculturism.' Phrases manufactured and designed to shut you up. There, I've said it. Again. The MOOBOSO club (mock-outrage-on-behalf-of-silent-others) will be out for my blood now. Toughen up, Beeb. You are NOT now always the demon. Defend your position, occasionally. But... the BBC is still, as I see it - and, at this rate per word, this is all that matters now - streets ahead of any other news outlet. The World knows it too. Except China, enraged innocents that they are. Sorry, it is. Credit where it's due ? Call it tough love. And I do love them. I do. Sorry, it. xx*****P.S. I feel I must note that, as I write, the 97% 'bad' rating across all reviewers of BBC News is, just patently ridiculous. And this, while the other 5% (somewhat confusingly) grace BBC News with something at least more enthusiastic than that. The 97% 'bad' figure otherwise speaks volumes that those who choose to review on sites such as these, do so disproportionately out of an 'outraged, self-nurtured' anger.Perhaps, then, less so out of a desire for wild praise. Trustpilot and others ferment the 'all or nothing' reviewer, I suppose. That's a lamentable reflection on all of us here. Across the board, that is to say. As for me.. excuse me while I adjust my halo. Speak for yourself !* Much improved since original posting. (We thank you) ** Still waiting. Innit.

title: BBC is great!! Not so for BBC News…
review: I'm not one of those ranting BBC haters, I have loved the Beeb for over 40 years and always will. Their entertainment shows, documentaries and dramas are superb. Radio 4 and and Radio 6 programmes are exceptionally good!  TBH, my life would be much more empty without it.My issue is with the political news and the reporters. For some reason it seems that the Beeb often allow outright lies and falsehoods to go completely unchallenged. This seems to be a general rule for most government ministers, but I also see it when reporters question opposition party's and other political commentators. Additionally, reporters often fail to ask blatantly obvious questions of political interviewees. To me it appears that the guest have dictated the terms of the interview before they agree to be interviewed. If this is the case, it should never be allowed in a functioning democracy, when talking to MP's. All MP's work for the people of these islands, all those that choose to appear on BBC news programmes must be ready to justify their statements to the people. The BBC should be the voice of the people (after all we pay for it) and it should not allow politicians, or think tank representatives or anybody else to go unchallenged on what they say. If not, then don't invite them to comment and report on the news subject anyway. Also, please stop reading out written statements as a response to a given subject. These are often used by indivduals or groups that are afriad to be challaged. If the characters concerned in a story are not available or unwillingly to appear then tough, run the story anyway.  I understand that there is a policy of impartially in place, but it is evident to all, that the policy is getting in the way of what used to be great journalism, or it is simply being used as an excuse for failure to properly address the concerns of the viewing public. Poor political journalism, leads to poor politicians. To those at the BBC if you read this, please bring back the great days of Paxman, Day and Frost and please grow a pair for the good of the country. That said, I still love the BBC, just not BBC News.

For example the nationwide loss of manufacturing and poor national investment/ transport links never makes it into the national BBC news - all seems to be about tube trains and London bubble news.Awash with the ArtsThe move to Manchester appears to be for light programs and production, BBC feels like it's essentially a London broadcasting corporation:BBC should either represent the UK - or - the government ought to remove their licence fee and allow it to be a state news organ/ state information broadcaster.BBC Radio shows invariably voice their characters as Northern if they are either agitators or uneducated. The working class of the South it seems are equally unrepresented in any Radio format except the Archers.Place an urbane BBC 'hero' character with erudition against an unruly mob and the mob characters all begin speaking with northern accents - perhaps a reflection of the BBCs decision to recruit heavily from Oxbridge - or a lack of decentralisation; ensuring BBC commissioning editors rely on their wives' production companies, wives' friends' or their wives' friends' tennis partners' production companies to supply the content... biased unrepresentative rot (my opinion here), and so much Bargain Hunt type trash - paid for by us.Light tatty format programs should be paid for by the commercial sector and see how much advertising that attracts.In my view nepotism is a rot which it's too late to excise from the once mighty oak of the BBC.Focused objective or scientific programming has been dropped, production on science shows has respected scientist-presenters commited to novelty antics and walking in long shots waffling to music and 10 minutes of scientific content is padded to an hour/ 50 minutes - I have a science background and their current production output rarely stacks up to an hour's worth of content in any given program.Weak content packaged well is weak programming and dreadful value for money,(in contrast look at early Horizons which were jammed full of science and the presenters appeared on camera for two minutes at the beginning or end)Is the topic the star of the show or the media personality?The BBC's content is emaciated, it lacks representative content at its core, imho BBC outsources its talent and is left owning nothing but expensive premises and overwhelming well paid executives and presenters.As for science - forget it: It appears they do have a couple of science graduates/ post-docs in a cupboard somewhere, but the BBC's key interviewers and presenters are rendered tongue-tied and impotent the moment an interesting science story appears in the  news; balance is lost - frequently - because BBC editors appear to have picked lunatic fringe cod-scientists to debate against respected experts from Imperial or other universities and industry. Who of any credibility would wish to appear on the BBC to be pitted against fringe groups and uninformed presenters?Sadly the Today program is also guilty of this at times and it pains me to hear 'debate' being generated between real scientists and flat-Earthers, or contentious scientific and statistical claims from government or big business going unchallenged by the interviewer.BBC please:Get some teethGet some geographic representation please, the provinces are 85 percent of the populatuion.Get some diversity of skill sets and disciplines, not everyone requires a PPE from Oxford to be a great journalist, producer or presenter.BBC you were great, you will pay for your lack of ambition.

When the records arrived, however, it was obvious that the vinyl had been handled because there were prominent fingerprints on the playing surfaces. In the case of one side of the live Captain Beefheart album (excellent album) the fingerprints were so dirty and ingrained that the album jumped! Fortunately, I process a vacuum washer for vinyl records, but it took two intensive cleans for the album to play without jumping. I was greatly disappointed by the inaccurate description of the B stock albums and will certainly not be tempted by the opportunity to save a few pounds in the future. If vinyl is to be handled it is on the outer edges and centre label only, dirty fingerprints on the playing surfaces is an absolute NO, NO! Anybody who doesn't understand this should not be selling vinyl records. Other than that, the order was processed promptly and delivery great.

title: ABN Andhrajyothi news is not boradcasted and the digital quality is not that great.
review: The digital quality of some of the channels is not good on my 85" LCD TV. I do not think it is an issue with the TV size, as the other apps perform well. I subscribed for a year to Telugu channels as my parents are here, and they mostly watch the news. I realized after subscription that they do not telecast ABN Andhrajyothy (which is a popular Telugu news channel. It seems that channel was earlier blocked in Andhra Pradesh, but when my parents called cable provider it was enabled). Here in USA they are saying the silly reason that it is blocked; Is the operator in USA or in AP/India? All silly excuses.

description: YuppTV is an over-the-top (OTT) content provider for South Asian Content, as live TV, Catch-up TV, and Unlimited Movies all over the globe.
title: Have only tried the trail period
review: Have only tried the trail period.  The trial period is for five minutes.  How are you supposed to test something in five minutes.  Should at least be seven days such as Now , Prime or Disney Plus do.  Think of going from sky to prime but need to be sure. The five minutes does not give enough time to decide.  In the five minutes did test the two stations interested in noticed Star Plus was not full HD seems to be maybe 720p picture was blurred.  With colours uk picture was sharp but seemed to look more like a movie than a drama.Think Yupptv still need to work on their quality of the stations.  Beleive needs to increase their bitrate to improve the quality of the streams.Think if paying monthly is expensive but if paying for the whole year.price is not bad as works out at either £12 or £9 but worried about the service based on some of the reviews on the website.

title: Bad service and customer care.
review: We have been a loyal customer to Yupp TV  for several years, but now the service is really bad. We were forced to upgrade and pay extra to purchase the SunNxt. The announcement was unclear on the date the Sun channels would be disconnected. All of sudden just before the Tamil new year all the Sun channels disappeared and demanded money to upgrade. The problem is the Sun Nxt app was not working as there was a technical issue, the Yupp Tv customer service team told us to wait for 24 hrs , and now they told me to contact Sun Nxt directly as they cannot resolve. No option to cancel the packages as well. I am just asking them to cancel and re-subscribe the same package through a different account in order to resolve the issue, but they are not helpful.Update: 16/04/2023 - Issue resolved: SunNxt team advised to contact the YuppTv customer service team again and after a couple of followups, YuppTv customer service team was able to resolve the issue. Changing it to 2 star, because of lot of time being spent on the call (everytime the call goes into the queue for 30 mins)

I got what I paid for, but the experience as a whole was disappointing, and I don't feel that Planet Offers was particularly bothered that a first time user was misled about the price and had a bad experience, given they just keep offering to cancel. 🤷🏻‍♀️

This great business is a step away from 5 stars and I’ll gladly provide a 5 star review if they become more proactive with their incomplete orders. I will order again.

title: Musicroom is great but Evri are not is…
review: Musicroom is great but Evri are not is the short form of this. I have 4 orders ongoing with Musicroom, the first made about a month ago. I think Evri have lost that package (which contains about 10 records) as they are advising to contact the sender. I have contacted Musicroom but have not heard back in about 10 days (this is understandable as its a busy time of year and I'm not really complaining about this). The other 3 orders Evri say they are going to deliver that day and never do and it goes to the next and the next. This may seem like an Evri review but Musicroom have chosen them to deliver their products so have to be held partly responsible. I can't imagine the losses of stock Evri have cost them, I hope they are well insured! This all said Musicroom themselves are a really good retailer.

description: Buy and sell concert tickets, theatre tickets, sports tickets and exclusive event tickets on GET ME IN! the leading ticket marketplace.
title: A mixed experience!
review: I recently bought 2 tickets to Sam Smith at the 02 in London for my daughter and a friend through Get Me In. When the tickets still hadn't turned up 4 days before the event, I called GMI to find out what was happening. Their number isn't on their site, but a quick Google search brought it up and I got through to them quickly. Turned out that the original seller had withdrawn the tickets from sale at the last minute (no explanation, but I was assured they would be banned from selling on GMI in future) and GMI were trying to find us replacements from another seller - which, to their credit, they eventually did. These replacement tickets only arrived the day before the concert, but the seats were marginally better than the original ones we'd booked and we didn't have to pay any extra. It's important to be aware that Get Me In is a third-party platform for people to buy and sell tickets - they don't hold them or dispatch them themselves, so you have to hope that whoever is selling your tickets is honest and responsible. I have bought from GMI before with no issues whatsoever - this was the first time I've had a problem. It has been my experience that buying tickets through GMI is significantly more expensive than buying direct from the venue, or from Ticketmaster etc. so all in all, I'd only recommend using them if there's really no alternative - they are pricey, and there's always the risk that you'll get a rogue seller who messes you about.

review: Gratitude for Ditto MusicI am incredibly grateful to have Ditto Music as my distributor. Their commitment to supporting independent artists like me has been nothing short of remarkable. From the very beginning, I have felt valued and cared for, and their exceptional service has truly made a difference in my musical journey.1. Responsive Customer Support:Ditto Music has consistently impressed me with their rapid response times. Whenever I encountered issues, I reached out via email, often late at night due to my time zone differences. To my surprise, they replied promptly, providing clear and professional guidance. Their understanding and supportive approach made me feel at ease during what could have been stressful situations.2. Support for Independent Artists:While I haven't explored all of Ditto Music's benefits in detail, I genuinely appreciate how they cater to independent musicians who may not have significant financial resources like myself. Their pricing structure is accessible, allowing artists like me to distribute our music without breaking the bank. Although I wish I could invest in one of their chart-related packages, which seem incredibly valuable for artists striving for greater visibility, I recognize that Ditto Music offers a variety of tools and resources that can help elevate our careers. Their commitment to empowering independent artists is evident in the way they provide essential services without imposing overwhelming costs. Thank you, Ditto Music, for being so kind and professional in your support.Conclusion:In summary, my experience with Ditto Music has been overwhelmingly positive. Their quick support and dedication to independent artists have left a lasting impression on me. I hope they continue to care for artists like myself and maintain their reputation as a reliable distributor in the music industry. Thank you, Ditto Music, for everything you do!

title: The Best Allrounder
review: Ditto Is a great service with a decent business model.  25 USD a year gets you unlimited releases and access to the team.    they don't force down extra stuff that you wont use, and any extra features you may want, you pay a small upfront fee for it.     The releases are fast and can be sent to stores in as little as 10 days.  If you want expedited releases, its an added fee, but you would want to take that time to do some marketing to help your songs take off... which is a point that they make at the screen to pick your release date.    The entire experience is pleasant, and feels like they care about you as not only a customer, but as a musician as well.     The one reason I will not give it a full five stars is that I wish they would update the UI a bit.  As of writing this, there is no dark mode.      As a night producer, each time I prepare to release, Its like being blinded by a flash bang.    i would still wholeheartedly recommend people to use this service over any other, and I have had people switch from services like Distrokid and actually thank me.

So In general I did not like that my recent releases went into the wrong genre on Beatport. The communication with Ditto was not effective or transparent either. At the end I still do not know why these releases ended up in the wrong genre. Did Beatport reject the tracks to change the genre? Or was Ditto not effective in communicating with Beatport on the subject? Not sure. In general I think it would be good to include sub genres for Labels that use Beatport on Ditto.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: I had a generally positive experience…
review: I had a generally positive experience with the upload process, it was straightforward and user friendly. However I was surprised to find that my account was flagged during the withdrawal stage. I've reached out to Spotify about this issue. As for customer support, it was excellent with other issues, but now that I want to follow up on my pending royalties it's been 10 days without a response. I'm hopeful that this will be resolved soon, and I'll update this if anything changes.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: Release review time
review: We were told our track had been approved and sent to stores, but a day later on the Ditto dashboard it is showing as still under review. The reason its important to have out track approved and sent to stores is so we can claim our Spotify for artist profile prior to the tracks release date. The reason for this is to give us enough time to pitch our first release to Spotify editors for playlists. Apparently Distrokid are faster with getting releases approved and sent to stores. But we think Ditto is a good platform and could be even greater if they just got releases sent out a bit quicker. I don't think its an unreasonable request since most new artists probably would want to have enough time to pitch there first release to Spotify etc. Spotify recommend pitching 2 weeks or more prior to the songs release date...

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: I’ve worked with Ditto for 5 years and…
review: I’ve worked with Ditto for 5 years and releasing music has been really simple and there tools are really effective. I’ve had zero issues when releasing music. The biggest problem I’ve had is royalties, they never tally up with actual and they have said ‘you don’t get paid in certain countries’On two occasions my account says no subscription (currently like that now) and I have a fully paid up subscription which is frustrating because I can’t withdraw or see any stats now.You can’t email them or raise a ticket either and I struggle to get the chat to work.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: Lost Member not being accepted
review: So, I am trying to upload a song titled "Lost Member", but it keeps on getting rejected. I am the only artist that preformed the song, but I do not have any copyright data available on me. I have uploaded the song before without any issue, but yet, Issues have occurred. I am furious about all of this. I do expect a response from you immediately. And yes, I do have proof that I own the song. I just don't have any copyright information, because I cannot afford to copyright my song.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: The issue was resolved But..
review: The issue was resolved But..After I reported my issue, it took almost three weeks and three different support staff for my request to be fulfilled, despite me uploading the requested assets three times. I'm especially thankful to Raj for promptly making all the changes I needed.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: Improve Support
review: Great pricing and a very good business model for the music industry. However, I opened multiple tickets and didn't receive any response to them. I have the label subscription, which means that you have priority in support, but now we are on April 12, 2024, and I haven't received any answer from Ditto since March 25, 2024. Improve your support and you'll probably be the best indie distributor.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: Ditto, a great way to get heard.
review: Ditto, reasonably easy to signup.  Making your first release, requires that you know a little about how the industry works.  How to format your sound files, create track art-work and add Artists and Contributors to your music.One big advantage of Ditto is access to Professional DJ Download sites, such as Beatport and Juno, on top of all the other streaming platforms that your music is sent to.  The cost to access Ditto, is most reasonable.On the downside, Ditto assumes that you know what you are doing, help & support can be rather slow and unhelpful.  In addition, the commission to earn royalties is excessive.PROS.  Easy, cheap, will get your music everywhere.CONS. Slow, insubstantial support, expensive royalty commissions.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: Great service, but a little slow on the processing
review: Mostly we love using Ditto Music to distribute our music. The biggest flaw, sadly, is the very long processing time for new releases, which gives us virtually no time for pre-subscriptions to playlists, etc.For newcomers like us this is very crucial and we hope Ditto will work on this issue in the near future.

The customer service is good and easy to get problems sorted, but I have had endless issues with releases. It’s great that ditto collect all revenue and give you the opportunity to sync your songs. To be honest, that’s the only reason I stay.

review: On the most part Ditto has so much to offer which is why I chose it, however my releases often only get sent to stores a day or two before my release. I've also been waiting for my artist chanel on YouTube for almost 4/5 months now.

review: What I dislike is that, you people are not really fast at replying. And the date of releasing a song is too long. It takes too much of day before you people can put the release to stores. You people should improve on all that.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: Takes too long to upload/provide changes for music
review: This platform takes too long to upload music (i.e 10 days). And if your music requires changes it tells on 8th or 9th day, After that again we need to wait for 10 days to release song. Because of this my 1 music got delayed by 1 month. Also promotion services are limited and too costly. I kind of feel this platform for music distribution is good for artists who have already been established. For underdog artists its not that supportive.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: I originally rated them really well
review: I originally rated them really well, however as much as their customer support (for the most part) is great, They always leave your songs or ep or album in review until a week at earliest before verifying it & sending it to stores. this means no pre-save link or with only a couple of days, no editorial playlists, & no chance of getting a good algorithm with it. I have complained to them multiple times now & they refused to respond. I gave them over a month, same issue. This is a big issue when it comes to online distribution & I will be changing distributors over this. If there's an error with any of the songs by that point too, the release date has to be delayed because they didn't check it soon enough.

This does mostly make sense for copyright reasons but they tacked on hate speech into the reasons which was incorrect and shocking. As a queer woman myself they thought I was misusing language that I certainly can use but I appreciate their perceived diligence

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: Ditto holds back your earnings
review: I bought a plan with Ditto a year ago. Everything worked fine with the music release and so on. The problem with ditto are the lack of payment. They have not made any payment for a year. When asking for payment they say that "some tracks was flagged by Spotify for artificial streaming". Well.. I have NOT done any artificial streaming of my tracks. If you do a quick online search. it reveals countless similar cases where Spotify’s advanced algorithms, machine learning models, and AI have wrongly flagged accounts for fraudulent behavior. Clearly, these systems are far from foolproof. Ditto jumps to action at Spotify’s command, even when the accusation is baseless. This shows that their platform’s dependency on Spotify overrides any genuine care for their customers, especially when they are falsely accused.This is not even the worst part. I have not yet renewed my plan with Ditto, BUT now they say that I need an active subscription to make a payout requests. In other words. First Ditto hold back my payment, then I need to pay for a new subscription to  withdraw the earning from my account that I earned several months ago..... So now I have to pay them again to get my money... (if they indeed pay at all)

review: Hi Everyone I've given 2 stars only because we can't rate without giving stars, but I've promised previously that I'll give Ditto a rating after using them, so this is to let you all know that I'm in the process of using them, and I will let you all know exactly how they perform. I will give an unbiased report here after my release.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.
title: Poor communication and support
review: Communication between me and the Ditto support team has been very sub-par.  Taking up to a week to respond to time sensitive messages and release deadlines.  The process of making edits and changes to releases is painful and now as a result I had to pay to expedite my release because support took too long to help me fix the issue AND now my release metadata is not correct after I paid for the express release. They flagged my release for having (feat *artist name*) in the title and I can mention well over 100 songs as a reference that have that same song title layout live on streaming platforms.  I am very annoyed.Very un-satisfied and heavily considering changing the service I use for distribution.I want a refund for the express release I paid for because I had my release set up and my support query's submitted in time to avoid having to pay for express release.  I likely wont receive one.  Consider other options before you consider Ditto.  Being one of the ONLY distributors with access to beatport releases (also something I had to pay for), I am heavily discouraged.

description: Music distribution & record label services company helping over a million musicians worldwide release music to major platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, TikTok, Vevo and more.

No chance to pitch for playlists due to the delay, which is really annoying! This never was an issue at Distrokit! Only switched to Ditto because of their cheaper Beatport deal, but kind of regret it now. Similar thing happened in my previous Ditto release 2 years ago.

On top of that you have no choice but to use Payoneer who have taken even more fees to transfer the money to your account.. i will be transferring my highest earning tracks elsewhere for distribution at the end of this year. Not good enough DITTO/PAYONEER

I love the changing off the kits and adjusting them to suit your style. Being able to play on the rims is great but no clave.

title: At first the piano was working fine…
review: At first the piano was working fine however after 5 months I have discovered these issues:1. The sustain pedal is very challenging to use as it only works if your foot is in a certain position or sometimes not at all2. Sometimes the sound cuts off which can be solved by turning it off and on again3.sometimes the crackling sound of an amplifier or speaker starts sporadically4.The headphones immediately didn’t work.Contrary to this side of my experience, the piano does have a good sound and some good sound effect options to play around and experiment with when playing. It is quite straightforward to use and I think from my experience would be best as a temporary option or for a first timer for practice. I appreciate I have been able to learn some great pieces on this piano, but if you buy it be aware that you may have to be patient with some malfunctions which can affect your experience. I hope this helps !

title: So I ordered a second hand 7 string…
review: So I ordered a second hand 7 string which said it'd been refurbished.. came with a damaged volume control and what seems for be cat or dog hair stuck to the bridge, the strings were old and black and the guitar had fingerprints all over it, exactly what did you "refurbish"? The box it came in just or did you take some psychedelic mushrooms and go through a whole trip where you believed you actually refurbished it? I mean the guitar wasn't even wiped down before it was posted, the price was fine for what I got but it was falsely advertised, would think twice before buying someone from again

It now plays as it was advertised.  I suggest you put some quality control on your supplier!

description:
The Folio Society publishes beautifully crafted collector’s editions of the world’s greatest books, each with newly commissioned illustrations or specially researched photographs throughout. For over 75 years, we have celebrated the unique joy derived from owning, holding and reading a beautiful printed edition of your particular favourite.
Our books can only be purchased new through our website, ordered by post or over the telephone. We deliver to book lovers worldwide.
Beautiful books
We publish exquisitely produced new editions of already published works, with some exclusive anthologies and short story collections. The books we select for publication are timeless – we know they will be enjoyed and appreciated now and in the future. Because each book is considered as an individual object of value in its own right, there is a variety to our design and style – the only uniformity is in the quality of every single edition.
Folio books make wonderful gifts for readers of all ages. Our editions range from the classic fiction to fantasy; science fiction to ancient and modern history; gothic tales to science – there is something for everyone. Please visit our website to see our current collection.
Customer service
Our UK-based customer service team are available to help with your order and delivery queries.
See our international numbers.
Lines are open:
8am to 10pm (UK time) Monday to Friday
9am to 5pm (UK time) Saturday to Sunday
We can offer an exchange or refund (excluding postage) if your book is returned to us within four weeks of purchase.

If for any reason a book does not meet your expectations, you may return it to us within four weeks and we will arrange for an exchange or refund (excluding postage).

title: What happened at Folio Society?
review: This comment isn’t really about my latest experience but really the perceived milieu around Folio Society lately. Staggered sales with no combined shipping, higher costs (even existing limited editions), and uneven pricing for international customers are negatively affecting your reputation and prestige. I am in the US and if you compared apples to apples on price by simply converting pounds to US dollars, we are paying an extremely high premium to purchase your books compared to customers in the UK and elsewhere. There are price discrepancies between the UK and other countries but not as great as the US. It is almost as if Folio Society hired themselves a US CEO and are thinking all about profit. I don’t see how Roadside Picnic LE could be $395 before and now is about 10% more expensive when the shipping costs haven’t changed—the book has already been printed. Anyways. I just wanted to let you know that your business practices have been a real let down lately.

For over 75 years, we have celebrated the unique joy derived from owning, holding and reading a beautiful printed edition of your particular favourite.
Our books can only be purchased new through our website, ordered by post or over the telephone. We deliver to book lovers worldwide.
Beautiful books
We publish exquisitely produced new editions of already published works, with some exclusive anthologies and short story collections. The books we select for publication are timeless – we know they will be enjoyed and appreciated now and in the future. Because each book is considered as an individual object of value in its own right, there is a variety to our design and style – the only uniformity is in the quality of every single edition.
Folio books make wonderful gifts for readers of all ages. Our editions range from the classic fiction to fantasy; science fiction to ancient and modern history; gothic tales to science – there is something for everyone. Please visit our website to see our current collection.
Customer service
Our UK-based customer service team are available to help with your order and delivery queries.
See our international numbers.
Lines are open:
8am to 10pm (UK time) Monday to Friday
9am to 5pm (UK time) Saturday to Sunday
We can offer an exchange or refund (excluding postage) if your book is returned to us within four weeks of purchase.

If for any reason a book does not meet your expectations, you may return it to us within four weeks and we will arrange for an exchange or refund (excluding postage).

title: Great books, poor choice of business partner
review: I’ve been collecting books for years and from Folio for the majority of them. While their books have got more expensive of late they are still fantastic quality, look fantastic on the shelf, in the hand and great to read.However, their choice of Evri as one of their couriers beggars belief. Why would a high end quality goods producer use such an awful couriers firm to deliver their quality products? I asked this question of folio. To be fair they responded quickly and, I thought at the time, personally and as such I was going to give them 4/5. BUT I noticed that the email they sent me was nearly exactly the same as the response on here to Daniel Isherwood just 2 days ago so Folio seem to be using the same cut and paste or pre-formatted responses that Evri do in their replies when you complain. Top prices for P&P (another book company I use charge half the amount and wrap and package them even better than Folio) should result in a top delivery experience, not that of Evri. Caveat emptor!

title: Good books, but...
review: I am extremely disappointed in Folio Society's recent decision to remove our ability to make purchases in Canadian dollars.  Forcing us to purchase in US dollars, while at the exact same time pushing through yet another round of general price increases, meant that most of their books instantly became about 30-40% more expensive one day to the next.  I like FS books very much, I've always been happy with the product and service, but I feel I'm being priced out of being a customer.  Future orders will definitely be fewer and farther between, unfortunately.

I eventually got the book but it seems the error in addressing it was from your facility,
