title: Not double boxed, guitar band and model exposed
review: As the guitar has a natural ebony strek, I wanted to see a picture of it before buying. They didn't accommodate me on that, even though the packers could have simply taken a picture on their phone, (or maybe threy didn't want to break the factory seal).I ordered on a Monday at around 1pm, so I wasn't too surprised that they couldn't deliver it next day. They did make me call them up later that day a second time to request a Wednesday delivery (even though, at that point they understood my delivery preference).When it arrived, the DPD driver did not require a signature or take a photo (from what I could see).The guitar was in the original factory box, with brand logo and product description and number on it.It had been opened before, factory seal was cut and resealed, so would have been easy for them to take a quick photo on phone for me (since it was expensive over £1500).The guitar was all in one piece, luckily enough. I think they relied too much on original packaging (one box and lightweight case inside). When I worked in a music shop I used to always have to pack any and all guitars (including factory boxed) in an additional box, not only to protect it but also to hide the brand and product information for security reasons. What if the box was left with a dodgy neighbour (who will know exactly what it is and could look up it's value) or just stolen by the driver?Overall, it got to me in one piece and I think GAK is an awesome company, and will buy from them again. To improve service, I would make sure DPD are taking signature and photo evidence on delivery. Be careful with exposing product information on expensive guitars and aim to double box all guitars sent out where possible.

title: This guitar was I think a Friday…
review: This guitar was I think a Friday afternoon job. Firstly the service and delivery was great. The guitar however is another story. Out of the box unplayable, fret board dry as a bone with too much relief, nut action too high, intonation a mile out, worst of all the fret ends appear to have been dressed with an angle grinder. I am reluctant to diss the seller as this was a factory sealed box so no one has seen this guitar since it left Mexico. As long as the truss rod does what it should it will become a good guitar.

title: This was a significant lifetime purchase that was disappointing.
review: This was a significant lifetime purchase of a Gibson Les Paul Custom. Sadly, the guitar arrived unplayable. It had not even had a basic set up with the bridge set so low the strings were lying on the fret board and pickups. To be fair, a quick fix and GAK have agreed to a local set up cost, but not at all what you would expect for a guitar of thus quality. In addition, although not really GAK's issue, the guitar was just left on our doorstep in freezing conditions. We have no idea how long it was there but certainly over an hour. It could have been stolen, or been damaged by the frost. Overall a very poor customer experience. The guitar, however, now that the bridge is the correct height, is amazing and has quickly become my favourite guitar.

title: Calendars for presents.

It is good service and I'm pretty happy with the product I receive even though the online creation can be a bit hairy (the usual issues of forgotten passwords, moving between devices, finding the odd photo which is not of the quality I'd hoped...). Previous years I have prepared an advance version, got it printed  to check I am happy with it, and then made my big order. This year I thought I'd done it for enough years I could go straight through .. but what did I find, but 10 calendars with identical pictures for March and April.  I've not binned them, just given them with a laugh and an apology, .... but I think it suggests a new service. PHOTOBOX, please will you offer a package of 'advance sample for bulk orders' for this and other goods.  I don't mind paying for all of my orders up front but it would be brilliant if you could send me a sample version and let me make amendments so all of the rest of the ones I have ordered could be right.

I also paid £7 for the fastest delivery to my address of the calendar for the U.S but this also ended up being no quicker than the usual delivery - I am aware you may say this is outwith your control up to a point.So, unfortunately, if the same restriction on US delivery prevails going forward, I would need to seek out another company to do my calendars which would be a pity as your products are always very good.I think at the very least this change in U.S delivery policy ought to have been highlighted clearly on your website.

title: Follow up to previous review
review: Back in September I posted a 1 star review following changes to the photobox website and the loss of previous projects and features. I feel however, for the sake of balance, I need to update my previous review. Whilst I am still unhappy with the loss of all previous projects and the loss of some features in the "upgrade" in view of previous good service I decided to give the new layout a try. I first ordered a photo book which was pretty easy to compile and the quality of the finished article was very good. I then ordered 5 calendars and again the finished calendars were really good - one slightly annoying feature was the calendars were for 5 different people and many, but not all, of the same photos were used in each calendar. Unless I am missing something though I had to upload each of these same photos into each of the 5 individual project files - surely there is a more user friendly way of doing this? One of the calendars received was missing the events and holidays even though these had been entered in the project file. On contacting customer service I received a helpful reply within 24 hours and a replacement calendar shortly after - so excellent customer service. In these circumstances I felt it was only fair to update the review and change the rating to 4 stars and will definitely use them again..

title: Cut short
review: This is the first time I’ve had problems with a calendar despite making one every year for the past 8 yrs as a Xmas gift for my mother. Unfortunately when this year’s calendar arrived there were 2 pages which had been chopped off short at the bottom. The whole border was missing on one of the pages.  Presumably the paper had not gone into the guillotine correctly. Anyway I contacted support immediately but didn’t get anywhere via the online chat or email. They both just gave me a “ticket” number so the next day I phoned to speak to someone. I was just hoping for a reprint to be sent asap so that I could take it away for Xmas. Well the guy in support made out it was my fault! He said the photos had gone into the bleed area and that was why the pages were cut short. Unbelievable. I had allowed for this and indeed designed it like this on most of the pages. January-August were all fine but September & November were cut short. In conclusion I did get a code to reorder another calendar but it didn’t arrive in time for me to take away so I will have to wait until I get back home to see if has been printed correctly this time.

title: Annoyed!
review: I have been ordering photo calendars from Photobox for more years than I care to remember!  However this year I was really annoyed by a change that you have made.  In previous years I have purchased calendar "credits" which allow you to benefit from a discounted product but you have to complete the purchase within a set period of time or you lose the credit.  This year the wording changed and it was an "E-voucher" that I purchased with a valid time of a couple of months, but otherwise everything seemed the same as previously.  But when I came to actually order my calendars using the E-vouchers, annoyingly I had to place 3 separate orders with 3 separate delivery charges.  In the past when using the calendar credits I was able to place one order for multiple products and pay a single delivery charge.  I understand that multiple items can make for a heavier package and therefore the postage costs can increase, but the additional costs for 3 calendars in one parcel are far lower than the 3 separate charges I had to pay.  Add into this the waste of additional packaging and also the waste of my time having to place 3 orders when it could have been just one - seems a bit mad to me!  The product is still good, but I was so annoyed it has made me think maybe it's time to look at other photo companies for next year.

title: Had a rather unfortunate experience…
review: Had a rather unfortunate experience with this lab. There was an issue with the developing and it just so happened that one of our rolls of films was ruined and unrecoverable. A defective pump ineffectively pumped developer in the processing tank, resulting in the roll of film coming out blank. They offered us a replacement b+w film stock and refunded our development order of two rolls of film. Coming from a large company that develop hundreds of film daily, this is a measly compensation for the loss of 24 photographs and memories we'll never get to see. Luckily we hadn't documented a special event like a wedding or engagement. I appreciate the situation was not deliberate, but the poor customer service did not help. We had to barter for more compensation, and in the end received a colour film stock of our choice plus £10 voucher. I don't think this went far enough. On top of this frustration, they were moving labs so we waited over seven working days to view our scans to see whether it was mine or my partner's film that was blank. This was our first time shooting on film and the first time using AW to develop. It's certainly ruined our view and we'll be trying local labs from now on.

review: I have always been impressed with the turnaround time from Simlab and the quality of prints is great value for money and much cheaper than other labs. title: Good reliable and quick service, just ensure you check the lenses are clean before using.
review: I hired two lenses,  the canon 24-70 f/2.8 and 70-200 f.2.8 IS. They were great and enabled me to create some superb images. In terms of the ordering and delivery systems they were delivered and returned without issue and all reserved online without any problems. Although the lenses were great (a thank you more to canon) and the delivery / ordering system of lenses for hire were straight forward I was not overly impressed by the condition the lenses were delivered in. I am a professional photographer and keep all of my equipment including lenses immaculately clean. This ensures longevity and also that you don't a) get undesired marks in your photos from the optics being dirty and b) get dust on your sensor from unclean lens base optics. I ordered two lenses but the two separate packages only contained one return label between them. Not a big issue but I was surprised as lenses for hire supply all of the packaging to return the lens safely which is great. I was just a little concerned that a lens could get lost. The labels have codes for each lens on them so I replicated the missing label using the correct code found on the packing sheet for that specific lens. Secondly both lenses required the optics cleaning. They both had dust on the outside of filter and the inside of the filter. The 24-70 lens was clean on the actual optic however the 70-200mm lens required the optic to be cleaned also. On the 70-200mm the base optic velvet material was dusty and had what looked like tissue residue on it. Lastly the lens caps on both lenses were dirty and the 70-200mm had what looked like mud encrusted in the rim. I ended up using 4 lens wipes and 30 minutes of my time. I of course always invest time in to cleaning my lenses after the are used however I did not expect to have to clean the hired lenses at my own cost before I used them.

I appreciate why wasn't allowed, but why was I told that it should be ok, then not receive any communication when they had changed their mind (poor service in my view). When the lens should have arrived, the driver did not follow simple instructions, which meant that the delivery failed. That meant that the lens could not be delivered until the next day. The day of the project. As I was scheduled to leave the house at 4 am, that meant that I had to cancel the project. This could have been avoided if lenses for hire had the decency to communicate.I wasn't offered any apology or refund. Again, poor service.I gave them the benefit of the doubt and hoped that the service would improve. Unfortunately, it didn't. When I hired the second lens, the delivery was fine. However, when the time came for the pre-paid courier to collect the lens, again, the driver failed to follow simple instructions, so the lens was not collected at the correct time.I did have a third lens booked for April, but unfortunately, I felt the need to cancel the booking and look elsewhere.Positives:The concept is great, the lenses arrive well packaged and in good order.I'm genuinely disappointed, as I had planned on using lenses for hire on a regular basis. I need reliability, unfortunately, I cannot rely on their service.

Furthermore being a new customer I needed to ask key questions about the returns policy and the courier I had paid for through the Lenses for Hire Website.  I was again dismissed rather rudely by the receptionist and my questions regarding the lens hire were left unanswered, the service was so bad in fact that I questioned the integrity of the website. Furthermore my receipt was incorrect leading me to believe I was overcharged as the basket checkout price of £76 was totally different to the receipt which had different figures and was for approx £28,000!  I strongly believe customer service especially to a new client is very important and i felt like the company was slightly dodgy due to the way I was being handled and the way my general questions were answered. title: Couldn´t even use the lens, delivery service and LensForHire support is terrible.
review: Unbelievably I never got to use or even see the lens, even though I paid for it. Here’s what happened: On the day of delivery DPD, the courier LensForHire choose to do the delivery, sent me an email warning that the delivery would be done between 15H58 and 16H58.  At 17H12 I received an email from DPD saying that they had just tried to deliver my parcel from LensesForHire, however, there was no-one available to sign for the order at the address. There were people available to sign the delivery, they just were badly informed by LensForHire, I clearly specified on my reserve what had to be done upon delivery! After discussing the matter with DPD it was arranged that the delivery would be done on the next day between 9H00 and 10H00. I waited until 10H40 and then left because unfortunately the Shuttle Train that crosses the English Channel wasn’t going to wait for me! So I had to leave without the lens that was delivered to my adress at 10h50, that´s 50 minutes behind schedule! I contacted LensForHire to explain the facts, strangely I never got a reply with an explanation or an apology; I only got the auto-reply emails explaining what to do to return the lens! After my return from France I booked the lens return courier. This time LensForHire choose JCA Courier. I called them to book the return and unbelievably they told me that the company that was doing the pick-up was City Links, subcontracted by JCA. I asked JCA when the pick-up was to take place and how could I contact City Links; their reply was that City Links could not be contacted and did not work with period slot bookings, they only guarantied pick-up between 9hH30 and 17H30 on 16th June. The lens was finally picked up at 15H30; I had to wait at home for almost a full working day to see my LensForHire saga come to an end.

We select books that we know your children will fall in love with, from treasured classics to the latest must-have series. With our extensive range of authors and genres, there is something for every child, from reluctant readers to eager bookworms. 

Our service doesn’t stop there: our friendly team are on hand to ensure that your shopping experience with us is enjoyable and hassle-free. You can be sure that your books will arrive on time and in great condition.

We look forward to being a part of your next story.
title: One of the items was missing…
review: One of the items was missing from the parcel when my order arrived. Had to email multiple times to get a response and when I finally did they said the item was now out of stock. Eventually got a refund, but took a while and was very inconvenient as the missing item was a gift and had we known they weren't going to send it earlier we could have order something elsewhere.

title: Your online ordering service is easy to…
review: Your online ordering service is easy to use which is good. But I'm afraid the delivery was very poor. I'm sorry for the 2 stars because it's not really your fault. I had expected an email to say the product was out for delivery but I didn't see one. The delivery man did not leave a card to say he had been. I then saw an email saying the books had been delivered, to which I replied they hadn't. It was only when I went to the garden shed to get some gardening tools that I found the parcel, which felt damp. Luckily the books were in cellophane which protected them. To say I am disappointed is an understatement. I wish I knew which service delivered the parcel so I could request they not be used again and I could avoid them.

title: Pip and Posy
review: Books were in new condition. Slow shipping and no response from customer service when I sent multiple emails asking for an update on the order status. Order was placed July 10th and shipped on July 25th. Titles listed were not the ones included in the set. The Friendly Snail was not included even though specifically listed in the item description. Instead The Christmas Tree book was included. We specifically did not want a christmas book, so had ordered this set instead of the one on Amazon. On the tracking it shows this item shipped from Amazon. Disappointed that item not as described.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Love ❤️
review: I really don’t understand the terrible reviews, granted cancelling is tricky but the ease of use is amazing the audible + is brilliant offering a huge selection of free (no credit) book. I love the timed feature for when I’m listening & know I’m going to fall asleep. A vast selection covering many genres. I bought a years subscription as a birthday gift to myself & it’s is so worth the money.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: AUDIBLE is the Best in its Class
review: Really do not understand the bad reviews.  AUDIBLE is by far the best for listening to books.  They have great offers and incredible selections of books all wrapped up in a very user friendly interface.  Reviews stating its difficult to cancel are very confusing also.  It's super simple and they do everything they can to try and please you.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: I value the service offered by Audible.
review: I have used Audible for a few years now and greatly value the service they offer.I pay for one book per month which I don't always choose within that month but I have never had a problem when I later chose a book.I take advantage of the Plus library and the various 2 for 1 and 3 or 2 sales on occasion together with the daily email recommendations. I have taken a number of online courses, many free, and have learned a great deal.The recordings are high quality and the choice of narrators top class.All in all, I get a lot of enjoyment from my monthly payment.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: I love my audible subscription
review: I love my audible subscription. I get the 2 credits per month option and I’ve been devouring books this way. Not had any problems. Been able to pause my membership when money won’t allow me to stretch to it and restart it smoothly. Picked up a few good titles in the sale.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: I am an Audible convert
review: I am an Audible convert, it makes walking the dog even more of a pleasure, and long boring car journeys are now a joy. Whatever issues people seem to have had strike me as unnecessary whining, and instead of manning up and sorting it out just complaining on an open forum. Shame on you. Most of the moaners seem pretty illiterate too, so perhaps there is a clue there. Don't be out off, its well worth the monthly subscription, particularly as there are now lots of included items too.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: I love audible
review: I love audible. I love reading but I fall asleep when I start - so audible allows me to learn and develop my knowledge and skills whilst driving to work or cleaning the home, or at the gym. I love it. I’ve had the monthly plan for a few years now and I always purchase extra credits. I don’t understand the other reviews, you can pause your membership and it’s easy to cancel online.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Great for selection of books
review: I have been a member since 2022 and have had no problems. Wide range selection of books, they always have deals on like 2-for-1, £2.99 sale. Also found it easy to cancel/pause membership, I’ve done that a couple of times due to financial change or just want to get through the books I currently have. I have an illness so I struggle with books these days and reading is one of my escapes. I love physical books, though after doing the 99p for 3 months deal I fell in love with the service. I really have found that audiobooks are a great distraction for pain flares, background noise (I work from home) and even during insomnia episodes. I also like that you can sample the book before buying with a credit - I have to listen to the narrator before buying to see if I gel with them or not. I also like how you get more for your money, you can purchase one credit a month and get access to a selection of free books which are always changing! Though if you cancel/pause you don’t get to keep the books or when they go back to a credit. However that doesn’t bother me just nice knowing I can read multiple books a month without spending extra. One thing I do wish they have is when they have a sale, is having a filter option that pulls through any wishlist book on sale. I currently have 13 pages and having to scroll through each month to see if any are on sale :)Apart form that I’m happy with the service :D

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: I'm not going to lie this is a…
review: I'm not going to lie this is a difficult 5 star review from me. I dislike intensity the parent company but I've got nearly 500 titles in my library, lots free from the plus catalog. The quality of the production varies significantly but that's subjective I'm not sure I'm qualified to comment

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: My self inflicted Issue quickly resolved- superb as ever
review: I mistakenly bought a daily deal with a credit rather than paying for it. The person I spoke to resolved the issue with no fuss, reversing the transaction and refunding  my credit. Excellent service and so much better than  recent experiences with other subscription services.P.S. I’m amazed at the number of negative reviews. It’s a monthly subscription so reading a book a month or storing books up to read sort of goes with the territory. As for book choice I have read/listened to  100s of books on Audible and it has enabled me to discover authors and explore subjects I wouldn’t have found any other way. If you love books you’ll love audible.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Never had an issue with Audible
review: Never had an issue with Audible since I started with them around 2015 I think it was. For the times that I had to cancel the subscription, it is a very easy process to do and that was that.Audible has a wide collection of audiobooks within different categories, and before too long, you will end up with a rather long wishlist of books. I have found some treasures on the site including all the radio broadcasts of Dad's Army, Fawlty Towers, Blackadder, and so many history ones to listen to. The app is easy to use and new purchases will appear there instantly. If you have an Amazon Echo smart speaker, then you can simply say "Alexa, play (Book title) on Audible" and the book starts.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Can't knock them
review: Have used audible for years on a subscription basis and never had a problem at all like alot of the reviews state and I have found it fair. Mainly :-  if I have wanted to leave I can put acc on hold or they usually entice me back with a lower monthly subscription for a limited time.If.i don't like a book you can return it without quibble. I'm sure there is a limit but I've returned 8 now over the years and been able to use those credits again.If you do want to cancel And don't know how, a simple Google search will show you and it takes about a minute

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: This is my favourite audio book…
review: This is my favourite audio book company.  My annual subscription works out as less than £4 per book.  The app is excellent.  I haven’t given five stars for two reasons.  There are far too many fake reviews.  I’ve complained about this before and it’s an easy fix but still they appear. There are one or two authors who I love whose books are conspicuously absent.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Not as bad as some say especially as it is an Amazon company
review: I find the negative reviews against customer services a little surprising. It is not as good as before Amazon bought the company but nearly always it is able to provide some support for the multiple technical failures of the system.Once you know how to work their system the bargains you can get are very very good.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Fairly expensive
review: Yes it is fairly expensive at £7.99 a month and if you are using it for 76 page books maybe you should just be buying the books, but there are some huge tomes out there available for the cost of the monthly rental, along with such things as various radio series available, complete and unabridged. I am currently working my way through the Harry Potter series - I never had the patience to read them.Stephen Fry is absolutely superb as the narrator, is a real pleasure to listen to and brings J K Rowling's stories to full and exciting life.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Fine, with a small gripe!
review: Fine, really. I can’t subscribe, like others my perfectly valid and liquid card is declined.  However, I am not too bothered as I purchase the kindle and audiobooks via Amazon, most of the time for less than the price one book costs directly through a month’s subscription to Audible. Those not available at a reasonable price through Amazon, I buy via Apple books.My only real gripe is that narrators of period books repeatedly pronounce valet as val-ay. A val-ay parks your car in an American car park. A valet (said val-et) is a gentleman’s gentleman. No need to confuse the two! If Audible could just let all those publishing via their app know this, the rest of the world can continuing going to hell in a handcart! Happy 2023, everyone!

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Customer Service
review: While I cannot comment on how good audible actually is, I had signed up to have a look but never used it. 4/5 months later I noticed I still had payments going out to them, spoke to Anshika who was very helpful and fully refunded me. I'd advise if you have any issues, go on the live chat they are very helpful

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Excellent customer service
review: Excellent customer service and very responsive. Some of the books can be badly edited or have narrators who aren't great, but it is possible to avoid those by listening to samples. Overall an extensive selection of books.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Prompt customer service
review: 28 May (4 STAR): I have revised up my review based on the good customer service I experienced. 23 May (1 STAR): It is impossible to contact the customer service. I signed up to £7.99/month package today. But once logged in, it forces me to buy the more expensive £13.99/package or I can't use it at all. Hence even though I have already paid for a £7.99/package, I have not been able to use it at all. I can't contact customer service by email or using the "help" section as it keeps taking me in circles.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Good but...
review: I do like audible, it makes it easy to listen to books without taking time out my daySome of the voice acting is a little off and not convincing and sometimes it's not clearly labelled that it's narrated in a different language

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: They Do Try To Make Things Right
review: I wouldn't normally bother reviewing a company like Audible but there's such a storm of 1 star reviews here and none of it matches the experience I've had, so I thought I'd share.I recently upgraded from the monthly to the annual subscription.  Based on my experience with customer services, I'm not worried in the slightest that Audible will "steal" my remaining 22 credits.I've had two experiences with their services, one brilliant and one meh.  I was listening to an included book that was due to leave the catalogue and become a normal paid-for book; it expired 12 hours before the stated time and I was cut off listening to it with 9 minutes to go.  A couple of emails back and forth and they just gave me a credit to make it right.  That's good service, isn't it?  My other experience was about reviews not being published - they are not transparent about why reviews don't get published and were generally no help at all in that case.  But I don't regard this experience as important as the one above, where they excelled.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Blank screen and no way to contact audible to report it.
review: 1. I get a blank screen when I open my app.2. The contact is email address just gives generic options and no way of actually contacting them.3. Others I know have the same problem…. And also found no way to tell audible about this problem.4. Update. Fixed! so happy now.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Change of heart error corrected by…
review: Change of heart error corrected by Audible. Had a later email where successfully received the 99p per month for 3 months.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: I was just about to cancel my…
review: I was just about to cancel my membership due to lack of use. Then I got drawn in to make the service cheaper. I thought why not if I don't use it then at least it's not as expensive. Then I got charged straight away which I am less than impressed with. I had just been charged £7.99 on the 20.04.22 meaning my membership was due to recharge on the 19.05.22. But I've just been charged an additional £3.99? I'm less than impressed regardless of the cheaper price.I can now say that the customer service team has refunded me the £7.99… so at-least they are helpful.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Great service use to pay for each…
review: Great service use to pay for each audiobook and thanks to their membership it’s way more economical - UX and recommandation are poor compared to Books from Apple

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: great concept
review: great concept, love using this and will continue to do so on now

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Credits. Cool but be honest.
review: OK. Firstly, it was hard to find a way to communicate with you. All I want to say is that I find the ads irritating. "Buy your credits now for less". The credits have cost the same for years. £18. £6 a book. Never changed in the time I have been with you. I always buy the credits. Why not be honest? "Buy another set of credits for the same price." As for my the rest, I love you. I am an Audible addict. So show me you read this and respond.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Love audible hate the app.
review: Love audible hate the app. I mean give me the option of folders to organise finished books, books in a series, genre etcI have the 24 book subscription didnt like the fact I couldnt just do it through the app and had to request a call customer services although the person was great and I was able to purchase during the call.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Books great, customer service poor
review: THe range of books is e excellent and good value if you take out a subscription. I’ve knocked off a star because if the often dismal customer service. If the question is not a simple one they don’t seem able to understand written English and give one fatuous formulaic replies. I’ve just had to contact them and got a reply that had missed the point of my question.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Wonderful service, glitchy app
review: The app itself is not the best - Audiobooks start to download then half will play and I'll get an error to say file corrupt. It can also be difficult when trying to locate a certain book because you have to search through every single file you've ever purchased. Some of the free content - the Audible Originals - are very good, but the reason for the four stars is that their customer service deserve the highest score. They really are a dream. Pausing membership is a breeze and they are very helpful. I only wish the app lived up to the service.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Flexible with subscription options
review: Their customer service is responsive and polite. I appreciate they let me switch plans and put my subscription on hold when I didn't have time to listen to many audiobooks. The range of content is much better than other audiobook sites.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Previews could be much better!
review: I like my Audible overall, especially as I can frequently pause my account for three months. All it takes is sending them an email to ask. It would be better to be automated however.My main gripe are the  book previews - which used to be great. Now they are full of music intros and forewords - all of which I've already seen in the book description!! I've just listened to two book previews and in both I've not heard the actual content or style of the book, so I've not purchased! Sort that out Audible! Just a section of the book midway would do!!

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Need a better help system, otherwise I love it
review: I love the audible app & despite my best efforts cannot find a better one. The reason for only three stars is; today I wanted to set up an account for my partially sighted husband with Alzheimer's. It took sometime to navigate the help system & get to a text person, this person was neither helpful or polite, hence my efforts to find a better app, I couldn't.  I finally got through to an incredibly helpful nice man on the phone, he helped me set up a gift account for my husband, who is thrilled. It's very sad that one very ignorant person ruined an entire day. I am hopeful that audible sort out their "help" section on their app. Then five stars

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Great app but …
review: I absolutely love the app but when you want to cancel the membership with Audible - it’s annoyingly difficult to find out how to do it. Please fix that @Audible!! I would have given 5 stars if it was easier to get out of the membership and I would also say I would be a returning customer at another time.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Impossible to prevent spam mail.
review: Although I'm glad that it has provided 2 months of free subscription time and tokens to go with it (for free recordings), I'm displeased that despite having all notification boxes unchecked, I continue to receive marketing mail. That's a violation of the EU DMA and US CAN-SPAM acts.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Not so happy
review: I’m generally ok with Audible, but I spent ages on the phone trying to enter-cancel-enter-cancel my bank card until it finally worked. I have listened to just one book since and have the same problem!! I don’t have the time nor the inclination to be constantly messed around, entering and re-entering, cancelling and entering my card. Please sort this out Audible….I think I was lucky to find someone to actually talk to because I can’t find the link now, all I get is troubleshooting drop down lists 😡😡Unsatisfied customer…if you’re even bothered!!

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: The audiobook side is great but STICKERS?
review: The audiobook side is great. Hence the stars. But you cannot give them feedback. Having encouraging messages saying 'keep going your doing great' is really patronising and odd. I'm listening for pleasure. Also being interrupted with 'you've just earned a badge' is just bizarre. I've started getting cross when I look at the app. No idea how to turn it off or contact the company. What is the point of a feature which simply irritates you? When the books and audible plus selection are actually really good.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: I was a long time subscriber
review: I was a long time subscriber, but today I have had two pre-orders rejected (after they were placed days/weeks ago) for failed payment (which is not correct as they were ordered using my existing paid for credits!) They may have cancelled the orders, but they HAVEN'T returned my paid for CREDITS used for the pre-orders. I have tried to call them over 10 times so far today, no answer, or I get through and then held in a queue and after 10-15 minutes they drop the call!Update: They did eventually fix the issue, but my trust in them is now very low.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Audible Exhausted
review: Audible Exhausted. Having bought over two hundred books from Audible (not including freebies and podcasts) I find it harder and harder to find a book I like. So I get a little annoyed when Audible doesn't like me returning ones I cannot get on with. The problem is twofold. I seem to be exhausting books I like and hence experiment with books that are not my first choice. The second is Audible itself. Despite the vast catalogue, the recommendations do not usually match my tastes. (this is also true for Amazon Kindle books)So, Audible, given that I am keen to experiment a bit, and given your recommendations are rubbish. Why make it so hard to return?

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Don't pre-order audible books
review: I have been a member for a few years now and am generally happy, thought it is too expensive. I have learned not to pre-order books as on two occasions I have been charged twice, which the company denies even though it appeared in my bank account.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Noreturn policy
review: I recently purchsed a title from audible using my credits. It was from a great author who writes science fiction, but when I started listening I found that it was a serial killer story. I wished to return it but was not allowed.Buyer beware.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: I have a monthly subscription
review: I have a monthly subscription. I listen to a lot of books and often buy more in the app outside of my subscription. I really think you should be able to return books as some narrators are boring and you end up giving up on the book due to a boring narrator but you can’t return the book.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Good service, but big problems with the subscription experience.
review: Good: Lots of titles, hearing a sample first, downloading and listening even after your subscription has run out.Bad: I have had several incredibly frustrating experiences with subscriptions. It's unbelievably clunky and hard to get anything done in this respect, when restarting a subscription (I often take 3 months off so I can use my credits without more building up).

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Sadly far too expensive.
review: I really love listening to audio books - it's such a huge treat. But I do find them far too expensive. It's just greedy. If they had a low fee loads of people would subscribe, but while it's so expensive we can only do it occasionally. They don't send emails when your monthly subscription is about to be paid either which isn't useful. Please lower your price or go back to free with Prime.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Good service but frustrating cancelation of credits if payment details expire.
review: I've been using this service for a long time and have mostly been enjoying it. I'm writing this review however as I've had an issue twice now where my payment card has changed and I haven't updated it because I had enough Audible credits to last me for a while and as a result Audible erased all my credits that I had already paid for. I spoke to customer service both times and they were immediate in restoring them but regardless as a policy this seems a bit forceful. Coupled with the fact that it is difficult to pause your membership for more than 3 months this isn't great. If as the customer I want to only listen to 1 audiobook every few months and not pay for credits credits faster than I can use them then I should be able to do this easily.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Ratings/reviews are misleading through omission.
review: I've been an Audible user for many, many years. The ability to listen to unabridged audiobooks at 1.5x or faster speed helps tremendously with my ADHD and means I can get through so many more books I want to 'read'. The customer service is good and I've not really had any issues.However, they lose 2 stars in my book as their ratings are falsely skewed. title: chapters out of sync
review: I’ve used Audible a few times now but currently I am on a title that is frankly, messed up and I’m shocked that Audible doesn’t seem to have a quality assurance team to prevent things like this from happening.  I’m reading Churchill by Andrew Roberts. This book has 34 chapters so the problem it has is evident for quite a long time.  The chapter that is playing at any given moment is out of sync with the chapter being read. This is because the first part of the book which was read was the introduction however the software being used to record this book lists the introduction as being chapter 1. So then throughout the other 33 chapters in the book it’s always one chapter off. For instance if you go to the chapter list and you press chapter 10 it will tell you that it’s chapter 9 that it is reading to you.  It’s just an annoyance that shouldn’t be there. Someone mentioned this in a previous review of the book but it seems audible doesn’t care.

description: UK's largest selection: 30,000 downloadable audio books. Huge discounts on bestsellers, unabridged audiobooks and new releases for iPod, PC, GPS and mobile
title: Audible - who is your customer?
review: I have had an audible account since the pandemic and love the fact that i can listen to books and have access  to them 24/7. However i find that as an organisation and given where we are in terms of our techno evolution very lazy and backward looking company - especially given the fact that we are not dealing with hard copy books ( where there might be a case for ‘selling/pushing’ surplus stock) but their digital equivalent;why do i receive a ‘Daily Deal’ for ‘Warhammer’ books or ‘Games of Thrones’ type books where hell would need to freeze over before I would even consider these as an option. Where AI abounds on ever aspect of life why oh why where with not much effort could you not take advantage of your incredible ability to ‘profile’ your customers and ‘pitch’ books that at least have a fighting chance or attracting interest?? Do you not realise that every time you send me a ‘Daily Deal’ like these you alienate me further and the minute someone comes up with an alternative to ?Audible that actually cares about their customers I will be off ( although judging by the feedback given on doing so you even make this difficult) even if you only offered 3 or 4 daily deals which somehow come nearer to my preferences I would feel slightly more enthusiastic about how you manage your customer base but a one size fits all approach is a product of pure laziness and ineptitude.

You have a maximum of 6 credits even if you keep paying monthly, so basically your ‘membership’ is just robbery after that point. Plus you ‘lose’ those credits if if you cancel so you delay cancelling till you have time to choose more books. But why on earth should you ‘lose’ what you paid cash for?? Overall the whole payment system seems manipulatively designed to tie you into ongoing memberships that are deliberately hard to get out of, because basically that’s how they make the most money out of you. Highly manipulative, lacking integrity, but that’s the corporate world. Sad when it colours the beautiful world of books they guard

description: The One Stop Galactic Bookshop offering the finest selection of Manga, Graphic Novels & Science Fiction to the denizens of Earth.
title: I love scifier but this was disappointing
review: I love scifier and the books always arrive well packaged and protected. However, it took 20 days to arrive. There was a dispatch delay from their manufacturer, which means they did lie when they said it was in stock. I was told that it said there was a dispatch date/time on the description of the books, which I did not see anything about, so I feel it should be made more clear that the books weren't actually in stock. I feel a little lied to. I will still order from scifier but will think twice from now on because I don't real like waiting a month.Edit after the reply: what you have said is a lie because you guys told me the books were delayed so it was infact NOT the correct date. And as I said you should make it more obvious that it's not actually in stock, because lots of people like me will look at the "in stock" sign and trust it.

description: The One Stop Galactic Bookshop offering the finest selection of Manga, Graphic Novels & Science Fiction to the denizens of Earth.
title: Inadequate packaging
review: After ordering a hardback from the shop, I was disappointed to see that it was packed with as little care as is common for Amazon (no padding, only cardboard). As can be expected, after the book went through the handling and shipping process, it ended up with a bumped corner. Hardbacks need padding - they're too heavy and when they get thrown around, the covers take all the impact.The one advantage smaller stores have over Amazon should be showing they care. Otherwise, a customer ends up with the same result while paying shipping fees on top.

I would not order this again for an adult and wouldn’t spend that kind of money for an advent calendar for a child either.

description: The One Stop Galactic Bookshop offering the finest selection of Manga, Graphic Novels & Science Fiction to the denizens of Earth.
title: Good deals Bad Service
review: Good for the deals, rude and bad customer service.I made an enquiry about the condition of a used book and received a very passive aggressive “ As stated in our site blog, we do not grade used titles.We are a small team who process thousands of orders per day and simply do not have time to grade used book conditions. All our used titles are supplied to us by trusted used book wholesalers.” I understand people have bad days but this is bad customer service, it’s your job to answer questions without being passive aggressive especially about information that is not possible to find on the item’s page. To begin with when looking for information about an item’s condition  it’s expected to find it on the item’s page like most websites that sell second hand items. There is no indication anywhere on used titles linking to a blog post on grading or sources of info or a disclaimer that SciFier doesn’t grade the used books. Why then, would anyone be searching for a blog to look for information? Nonetheless I looked for this blog:  There is no indication of any blog on the side bar or at the bottom of the website page either so what’s going on here exactly? There is no way to easily access any blog (I’ve yet to find it) and no way of understanding that Scifier doesn’t grade books so why is she being so passive aggressive like the customer should already know this? Put this info on the item’s page if your staff don’t want to answer very normal enquiries. It’s really put me off buying as much as I’d like to from the site
